name: Psycho-technologist (Artificer Archetype)
body:
A psychotechnologist seeks to expand the mind through the use of magi-tech.

Psycho-technologic Implant (Ex)

At 1st level, the psychotechnologist has created an implant that grants them psychic power. Their spellcasting is treated as psychic magic and requires emotion and thought components. Their spellcasting operates like a psychic but their spells per day and spells known are as a summoner.

In addition to the artificer spell list, the psycho-technologist may learn any spell available to the psychic. Additionally, they gain an additional spell known for each spell level that must be a divination spell from the psychic spell list.

This ability replaces spells, the bonus metamagic feats at 3rd and 15th level, all instances of metamagic spell trigger, and metamagic spell completion.

Psychic Sensitivity

At 1st level, the psycho?technologist gains Psychic Sensitivity as a bonus feat. This ability replaces scribe scroll.
